### Summary of Last 30 Mails

#### 1. Jira Notification (Priority: High)
- **From:** jira@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** New issue assigned to you: PROJ-4821 – Fix null pointer in payment gateway retry logic
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:29:36Z
- **Summary:** A new Jira issue has been assigned to Maria to fix a NullPointerException in the payment gateway retry logic before the code freeze on Thursday.

#### 2. GitLab CI Notification (Failed Pipeline)
- **From:** gitlab-ci@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Pipeline #1204 FAILED – etl-service / feature/partition-pruning
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:29:36Z
- **Summary:** The GitLab CI pipeline #1204 failed on the build-runner-07. The test_partition_cleanup job failed due to stale partitions not being dropped as expected.

#### 3. PagerDuty Alert (CRITICAL)
- **From:** pagerduty-alerts@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Memory usage on prod-db-cluster-02 exceeded 95% threshold
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:29:36Z
- **Summary:** A critical alert is triggered for high memory usage on prod-db-cluster-02. The top consumers are report_batch_job and analytics_etl. Suggested actions include rescheduling the report_batch_job or restarting the ETL worker if necessary.

#### 4. GitHub Notification (PR Merged)
- **From:** notifications@github.com
- **Subject:** [PR Merged] adventure-works/adventure-works-api #317: Add idempotency keys to order endpoint
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:29:36Z
- **Summary:** Pull Request #317 has been merged into the main branch, adding idempotency keys to the order endpoint.

#### 5. Fabrikam Notification (Billing Discrepancy)
- **From:** tom.reyes@fabrikam.com
- **Subject:** FW: Billing discrepancy on Fabrikam account – Ticket CS-2025-5108 (P3)
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:00Z
- **Summary:** Fabrikam was charged for 12,000 excess calls but their internal dashboards show they never exceeded the 10k/min cap. The ticket requests raw gateway counters for reconciliation.

#### 6. API Deprecation Notice
- **From:** r.novak@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** API deprecation: /v1/batch-export endpoint – migration notes
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z
- **Summary:** The /v1/batch-export endpoint is deprecated and will return 410 Gone on January 15, 2026. The new endpoint `/v2/exports` should be used instead.

#### 7. CI/CD Notification (Failed Pipeline)
- **From:** ci-cd@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** 🔴 BUILD FAILED – [nightly-e2e] pipeline #8841 – 3 tests red
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z
- **Summary:** The nightly e2e pipeline #8841 failed due to issues in three test jobs. Likely cause is a variant dropdown returning 2 options instead of 4.

#### 8. All-Hands Follow-Up (Action Items)
- **From:** a.chen@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** All-hands follow-up: action items from Sept 5 session
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z
- **Summary:** Action items from the Sept 5 All-Hands meeting include an accessibility audit, customer feedback synthesis, internal style guide update, and PTO policy updates.

#### 9. Database Migration Credentials
- **From:** admin@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Database Migration Credentials – Q4 Maintenance Window
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:33:02Z
- **Summary:** Sharing DB migration credentials for the Q4 maintenance window. The credentials should be stored in the Vault and deleted after use.

#### 10. Security Policy Update (Action Required)
- **From:** security.policy@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** [Action Required] 2025 Security Policy Update – Mandatory Acknowledgment by Aug 1
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z
- **Summary:** The 2025 revision of the Enterprise Security Policy mandates MFA enforcement for all systems, endpoint encryption to AES-256, and stricter vendor access token validity.

#### 11. FY25 Go-to-Market Strategy Update
- **From:** s.vasquez@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** RE: FY25 go-to-market strategy – draft v2 for review
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z
- **Summary:** Draft v2 of the FY25 go-to-market strategy is ready for final review, with headline changes including a budget shift for mid-market verticals and accelerated timelines for key projects.

#### 12. Invoice Dispute
- **From:** m.torres@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** RE: Invoice #LI-2024-0847 – Project Falcon – Disputed Line Item
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:45Z
- **Summary:** Disputing line item #1 of invoice LI-2024-0847 due to overbilling for Project Falcon's June delivery window.

#### 13. Travel Policy Update
- **From:** travel.finance@contoso.com
- **Subject:** [EXTERNAL] Travel Policy Update – Q3 Per Diem Adjustments & Booking Window
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z
- **Summary:** Contoso Travel & Expense Policy updates effective September 1, 2025, including per diem adjustments and booking window changes.

#### 14. Escalation Needed
- **From:** lisa.okafor@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Escalation needed – CS-2025-4471 blocking go-live
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:00Z
- **Summary:** Escalating CS-2025-4471 to Tier 2 by 15:00 today due to webhooks module returning 500s on the customer's sandbox keys.

#### 15. PR Merged Notification
- **From:** notifications@github.com
- **Subject:** [enterprise/api-gateway] PR #1204 merged: Rate-limit header propagation fix
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z
- **Summary:** Pull Request #1204 has been merged to fix rate-limit header propagation issues on upstream 502 responses.

#### 16. Invoice Mismatch
- **From:** s.meyer@fabrikam.com
- **Subject:** Urgent: Invoice mismatch on Enterprise tier – Order #ORD-20251142
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:32:26Z
- **Summary:** Invoice INV-88412 shows an overcharge of $1,105.00 for the Enterprise tier and incorrect API exceedance charges.

#### 17. Q4 Compute Budget Update
- **From:** j.tanaka@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Q4 compute budget – headroom update
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z
- **Summary:** Q4 GPU allocation has ~14% headroom left, about 220 A100-equivalent GPU-hours above current burn. Projects needing a bump must ping Jun before the 20th.

#### 18. Data Retention Policy Implementation
- **From:** compliance.legal@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** RE: Data Retention Policy v3.2 – Implementation Timeline & Config Changes
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z
- **Summary:** Legal has finalized Data Retention Policy v3.2, effective October 1, 2025, with a 6-week migration window. New classification-to-retention mappings are provided.

#### 19. Redis Memory Alert
- **From:** monitoring@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** [CRITICAL] prod-redis-03 – Memory usage at 94.2% (threshold: 90%)
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z
- **Summary:** Memory usage on prod-redis-03 is at 94.2%, triggering a critical alert. The working set for the sessions cache has grown past the 8 GB allocation.

#### 20. Sprint 47 Burndown Report
- **From:** jira@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** Sprint 47 burndown – 6 days remaining, 31 story points left
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z
- **Summary:** Sprint 47 has 6 days remaining, with 31 story points left across 9 open tickets. The largest single item is PROJ-4819, which needs to be completed with a fallback Vault-backed rotation.

#### 21. Deploy Notification
- **From:** deploy-bot@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** FW: Deploy successful – gateway-service v2.14.3 → production (canary 100%)
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:29:36Z
- **Summary:** The deployment of gateway-service v2.14.3 to production via a canary strategy was successful with a 22-minute duration and 48 ms p99 latency.

#### 22. New MFA Enforcement (Policy SEC-2025-014)
- **From:** it-security@enterprise.local
- **Subject:** FW: New MFA Enforcement – Service Accounts
- **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z
- **Summary:** From August 15, 2025, all service accounts used in CI/CD, IaC, and deployment pipelines must have MFA enforced. The timeline includes warnings, hard enforcement, and decommissioning of legacy token endpoints.
